dedupe_keys.name: data underlying the research of positive displacement reversible pump turbine tu braunschweig design

description: NTNU provides a configured reversible lobe pump-turbine design study for low-head pumped-hydro storage. The source describes design calculations and 2.5-dimensional CFD simulations for a model-scale rig at TU Braunschweig. Results include flow rate, power, efficiency, torque and pulsation. TwinMesh creates deformable meshes and exports the setup to ANSYS CFX; two reference CFX configurations represent pump and turbine operation. Coverage: Complete observation dates and geographic extent are unstated.. Access: public native metadata describes the identified research release. Licence: CC-BY-NC-SA-4.0. Current file access and cost are unknown. Related resources have separately identified native releases. Caveats: Reference stator mesh and project descriptors do not establish all required meshes. The source explicitly states that reference CFX files need generated meshes and a valid TwinMesh licence before running. Numerical boundary conditions remain in an unread thesis chapter. Its simulation use concerns the described reversible pump-turbine design.
